title: With AP/AR OFF but Reports ON, all 6 AP/AR aging reports are still listed
custom_preconds:
1. A user has a role with the Reports page access ON and View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF.
  2. There is some invoice/payment data so the reports have rows.
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top navigation.
  2. Look at the list of reports.
  3. Find the 6 aging reports: AR Aging Summary, AR Aging Detail, AR Aging Collection, AP Aging Summary, AP Aging Detail, AP Unpaid Invoices.
  4. Open AR Aging Summary.
  5. Go back and open each of the other 5 aging reports.
custom_expected:
The Reports page opens.

All 6 aging reports are listed even though View and Manage AP/AR Data is off (aging reports follow the Reports page access).

Each report opens and shows its data with no permission error.

No aging report is hidden or blocked because AP/AR is off.
viu_status: Blocked-UI; NOTE prior run FAILED here (aging still hid with AP/AR OFF) — re-test live
evidence: RUN331 recorded this as a FAIL (aging reports still gated by AP/AR, not Reports). Needs a fresh live re-test.
